name: TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0
notes: head_dim derived = 2048 / 32 = 64. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 22 * 4 * 64 * 2 * 2 = 22528 bytes/token at bf16 — the lowest of any decoder in this slice, and it shows why: an 8:1 GQA ratio with a small head_dim. Per layer 1024 bytes/token. At its 2048 context that is only 44 MiB of KV, so this model is almost entirely weight-bound and quantizes to very little; that combination (1.1B params, 22 MiB of KV) is why it remains a popular CI/fuzzing and llama.cpp smoke-test target. 1.36M downloads and 1836 likes make it one of the most-downloaded sub-1.5B models on the Hub. max_position_embeddings is only 2048 — that is the real limitation, not quality; anyone quoting TinyLlama as a 'long context' model is wrong. vocab 32000, intermediate 5632, untied embeddings, rope_theta 10000. TheBloke GGUF and onnx-community ONNX ports both exist.
